title: Sidecars lose the pod-wide securityContext they inherited

detection.reason: which container inherited its securityContext from the pod cannot be recovered from the rendered workload — an inherited value and an explicit one look the same

quote: Karpenter moved its `securityContext` constraints from pod-wide to only applying to the Karpenter container exclusively. If you were previously relying on the pod-wide `securityContext` for your sidecar containers, you will now need to set these values explicitly in your sidecar container configuration.
remediation: If you run sidecars alongside Karpenter, set their `securityContext` explicitly. The constraints move to the Karpenter container alone, so anything that was relying on the pod-wide settings comes up with the cluster defaults instead.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy,daemonset -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image? // "" | test("karpenter/controller")) | "\(.kind)/\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image)"'  # the Karpenter controller workload and the exact version tag it runs -- then read each container's securityContext
